cases.purpose: Exercise block capacity for shrinking, rounding and reference-based sizing, plus continuation after a device error; verify image and capacity after each attempt.
cases.comparison: Compare status, diagnostics, regular-file effects, block capacity and backing image digest; loop device belongs to this fixture and is detached on exit.
cases.script:
set -u
RT=/tmp/truncate-block-relative
/usr/bin/mkdir -p "$RT" || exit 1
cd "$RT" || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'open("img", "wb").write(bytes((i*7+i//251)%256 for i in range(65536)))' || exit 1
before=$(/usr/bin/sha256sum < img) || exit 1
d=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -f --show img) || { echo SETUP-FAILED; exit 1; }
[[ $d == /dev/loop* ]] || { echo SETUP-FAILED; exit 1; }
cleanup() { /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$d" || echo DETACH-FAILED; }
trap cleanup EXIT
/usr/bin/udevadm settle -t 10 >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
run() {
  local label=$1 rc size digest; shift
  "$@" >out 2>err; rc=$?
  size=$(/usr/sbin/blockdev --getsize64 "$d") || exit 1
  digest=$(/usr/bin/sha256sum < img) || exit 1
  printf '%s status=%s out=' "$label" "$rc"; /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' <out
  printf ' err='; /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' err | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'
  printf ' capacity=%s image-unchanged=' "$size"
  [[ $digest == "$before" && $size == 65536 ]] || { echo NO; exit 1; }
  echo yes
}
for s in -512 /5000 '<70000' '>1' %65536; do run "size[$s]" truncate -s "$s" "$d"; done
printf 12345 > ref
run ref-relative truncate -r ref -s +2 "$d"
printf abcdef > regular
run multi truncate -s 2 "$d" regular
printf 'regular='; /usr/bin/cat regular; echo
[[ $(<regular) == ab ]] || exit 1
/usr/sbin/losetup -d "$d" || exit 1
trap - EXIT
